content.source: brd.md L7 (no native pages, no nav, --no-pages); PART A A2 L55-L58 (never add pages: a page auto-grant turns readers into editors); security.hard_rules SEC-HR1; roles[].journeys
content.build_requirement: Generate and build ONLY with --no-pages. No native page, card, menu or landing may be created in CIQ_Digital_A00 by this run.

hard_rules.rule: pages = [], nav.menus = [], landing = {}. Backend only; the Workbench custom UI is built later.
Every generate/build of this spec uses --no-pages. A native page/card auto-grants its target roles as editors and would break every View-only cell (SEC-HR1).

No page, card, menu or report tile may ever reference CIQ RMES Safety or CIQ RMES Regulatory for a role that only reads it (every role except ciq_safety_reviewer on CIQ RMES Safety and ciq_regulatory_reviewer on CIQ RMES Regulatory). Applies to any later native or Workbench surface that uses native page bindings.

intended_workbench_landings._note: DOCUMENTATION ONLY. Not compiled, not built. Input for the later Workbench custom UI.
intended_workbench_landings.ciq_rmm: My CIQ work: CIQ Case tasks (create, Waiting for supplier, Scope check, Completeness PS-05, open-items checks, Review – RMM, final release), CIQ Open Point Waiting for supplier / Review – RMM, CIQ Change Request Triage; plus supplier master (CIQ Supplier) and case search.
intended_workbench_landings.ciq_regulatory_reviewer: Regulatory review queue: CIQ Case Review – Regulatory, CIQ Open Point Review – Regulatory, CIQ Change Request Assess – Regulatory; own RMES sheet (CIQ RMES Regulatory, editor).
intended_workbench_landings.ciq_safety_reviewer: Safety review queue: CIQ Case Review – Safety, CIQ Open Point Review – Safety, CIQ Change Request Assess – Safety; own RMES sheet (CIQ RMES Safety, editor).
intended_workbench_landings.ciq_qm_reviewer: QM review queue: CIQ Case Review – QM, CIQ Open Point Review – QM, CIQ Change Request Assess – QM. No RMES surface.
intended_workbench_landings.ciq_microbiology_reviewer: Microbiology review queue: CIQ Case Review – Microbiology, CIQ Open Point Review – Microbiology, CIQ Change Request Assess – Microbiology. No RMES surface.
intended_workbench_landings.ciq_sustainability_reviewer: Sustainability review queue: CIQ Case Review – Sustainability, CIQ Open Point Review – Sustainability, CIQ Change Request Assess – Sustainability. No RMES surface.
intended_workbench_landings.ciq_overall_approver: Overall approval queue: CIQ Case Overall approval tasks. No RMES surface.
intended_workbench_landings.ciq_business_admin: Configuration: CIQ Config Version (publish, release bundles). No RMES surface.
intended_workbench_landings.ciq_reader: Read-only case search and audit trail: CIQ Case, CIQ Audit Event. Read-only; no create action, no RMES surface.
intended_workbench_landings.ciq_case_admin: Case administration (cancel, reactivate) within the CIQ RMM landing; members also hold CIQ RMM (SEC-HR2). No RMES surface.
